coverage.source_system: Field ticketing (OpenInvoice / field data capture style)
Commodity market prices (Platts / Argus / NYMEX style)

ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: IS-Oil upstream tables (simulated, representative names): OIUH_WL/OIUH_WC wells, OIUH_VL allocated volumes, OIUR_VAL PRA valuation, OIUR_DOI division orders, OIUR_DIST owner distribution; plus LFA1, BKPF/BSEG and RBKP/RBCO (LOE invoices with WBS).

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: Upstream tables in S/4 shape (simulated, representative names): OIUX_WELL, OIUX_VOL, OIUX_VAL, OIUX_DOI, OIUX_DIST; owners as business partners (BUT000), the Universal Journal ACDOCA, RBKP/RBCO.

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: Cross-industry InfoProviders only: GL line items (0FIGL_O14 style), LOE vendor invoice items and business partners. No IS-Oil upstream content: no wells, volumes, valuation, division orders or owner distribution.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: EntryViewJournalEntry, SupplierInvoice, BusinessPartner, FunctionalLocation (wells). SAP BDC has no IS-Oil data products: UHPM volumes, PRA valuation, division orders and revenue distribution are gaps.

LAND_LEASE.name: Land & lease management (Quorum / Enverus style)
LAND_LEASE.note: Leases (royalty rate, term), tracts by well and owner interest decks: the system of record for title, compared with PRA division orders.

FIELD_TICKETS.name: Field ticketing (OpenInvoice style)
FIELD_TICKETS.note: Approved field service tickets by well and vendor, referencing the vendor invoice number; LOE as worked, before the invoice.

MARKET_PRICES.name: Market prices (Platts / Argus / NYMEX style)
MARKET_PRICES.note: Daily settles for WTI Cushing / Midland, MEH, Mars, Henry Hub, Waha, Houston Ship Channel and Mont Belvieu NGL.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
